description: Serve one INF-02 autonomic-routed completion request: the sys:autonomic holder session calls this with the request_id from its inference_completion_request bridge event plus the completion text it produced. The verb CAS-transitions the durable core inference_completion_request row pending-to-served (exactly one serve wins; a repeat reports already_served and submits nothing) and, on the CAS win, submits the consumer's resume continuation named by the row's resume_process_key — for planning requests that is resume_thinking_completion, which re-enters the planning loop with the served text. Unknown request ids and already-failed requests are typed rejections.
embedding_description: Answer an autonomic completion request with generated text: the session holding the autonomic slot calls this after receiving an inference completion request carrying a request id, purpose, and messages. Serves the durable request exactly once and resumes the planning flow that was waiting on the text. The response half of the autonomic inference queue.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: status (served on the CAS win; already_served / already_failed / unknown_request as typed rejections), request_id, resume_process_key (the consumer continuation submitted on a win).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the request was served and the resume continuation submitted. On already_served, another serve won the CAS first — the completion was not double-applied; nothing further to do.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: CAS-transitions the durable core inference_completion_request row pending-to-served, then submits the row's resume_process_key as a platform-owned continuation action (Pattern 6a returned-action submission). The serve CAS is the idempotency gate.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: missing_argument: request_id or text was empty. unknown_request: no live row carries that request_id (mistyped, or hard-cleaned). already_served: a prior serve won the CAS - the completion is already applied. already_failed: the request failed terminally (requeue attempts exhausted) before this serve arrived.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: already_served: nothing to do; the resume already ran. unknown_request: re-read the request_id from the inference_completion_request bridge event. already_failed: the requesting flow will not resume from this request - check the completion request row's failure_reason and the requesting surface's state before re-driving the work.
